# watchpoint_rum_site (Data Source)

Looks up a single Real User Monitoring (RUM) site by name within the tenant.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "watchpoint_rum_site" "example" {
  name = "Marketing Site"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the RUM site to look up (case-insensitive).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `domain` (String) Primary site origin.
- `id` (String) RUM site ID.
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the site is collecting.
- `public_key` (String) Server-generated public key embedded in the install snippet.
